# EvChart

> The titled frame a chart sits in: title, subtext, header action, summary and legend around the chart slot.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:chart` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvChart } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvChart>` or `<ev-chart>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/chart/EvChart.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<figure class="ev-chart">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvChart
  title="Realisasi Anggaran"
  subtext="Jan - Jun 2026"
>
  <EvBarChart :data="data" category="bulan" :series="['realisasi']" />
</EvChart>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

Its default slot is built to hold `EvBarChart` (`evoq-ui:bar-chart`), `EvLineChart` (`evoq-ui:line-chart`), `EvPieChart` (`evoq-ui:pie-chart`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'card'` \| `'no-card'` | `'card'` | no | `card` wraps the chart in a surface; `no-card` renders it bare. |
| `title` | `string` | — | no | — |
| `subtext` | `string` | — | no | Figma's `Has Subtext`: a muted line under the title - a range or unit. |

## Slots (6)

| Slot | Description |

| `default` | Figma's `Chart Slot`: the visualisation itself. |

| `headerAction` | Figma's header `Slot`: an action such as a filter or menu. |
| `summary` | Figma's `Has Summary`: the KPI row above the chart. |
| `legend` | The series legend, between the summary and the chart. |

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Chart**, frame `4220:71982` (Chart). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Visualize quantitative data — comparisons (bar), trends over time (line), or part-to-whole proportions (pie/doughnut). Wrap in the Chart container for a titled card.

### When not to use

- A few values better shown as text or a table. Pie charts for more than ~5 slices or precise comparisons — use a bar chart (`evoq-ui:bar-chart`) instead.

### Do

- Pick the chart type that fits the data question. Keep color usage consistent across series. Add value labels when exact figures matter.

### Don't

- Don't mix unrelated series in one chart. Don't use 3D or decorative effects. Don't omit axis labels on bar and line charts.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvChart`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<figure class="ev-chart">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:chart` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
